entities.summary: Al-Shanfarā was a semi-legendary pre-Islamic poet tentatively associated with Ṭāif, and the supposed author of the celebrated poem Lāmiyyāt ‘al-Arab. He enjoys a status as a figure of an archetypal outlaw antihero (su'luk), critiquing the hypocrisies of his society from his position as an outsider. Shanfara was a poets & playwrights (401 CE–600 CE). Holds notable historical significance, documented across 0 language editions of Wikipedia.
